name: Promotion
description: Coupons and offers: code coupons with a rule engine (minimum cart, scope, caps, usage limits, first order, new customers, channel, payment method, validity), platform- or seller-funded discounts allocated pro-rata to order items, automatic offers, the cart and checkout coupon box with available offers, flash deals with time-boxed variant prices, stock caps and a home countdown section, referral codes with reward coupons, seller coupons, admin CRUD, bulk codes and the promotion report.
